Quick note — outreach agreement for Acme Corp is up for renewal on 2026-11-15. Based on our records you currently have 210 seats (active: 165). Attached is a pricing summary and a couple of bundle scenarios (Outreach_pricing_q3_2026.pdf). High level:

- Option B: Seat reduction to 160 + 6% discount, one-time onboarding credit
- Option C: Bundle with HubSpot (combined term) — potential 12–15% blended discount subject to HubSpot approval

Can we set aside 30 minutes tomorrow to run the numbers with your ops/finance folks? Ideally I can bring a formal quote and the bundle outline.

Thanks,

Thanks Jonas — attached is a quick model (seat_realloc_model.xlsx) showing three scenarios: status quo (210 seats), right-size to 160, and phased reduction (185 first year then 160). Key takeaways:
- Immediate reduction to 160 yields ~22% seat savings on MRR but we should expect a one-time enablement delta for SDRs (~$12k) and potential churn impact in month 1–2.
- Phased plan (185 -> 160 over 6 months) smooths ramp and keeps full SDR coverage for renewal cycles but only saves ~12% in year 1.
- Bundle with HubSpot looks attractive on list price but HubSpot requires a 24‑month combined term for the 15% sweet spot. That increases contract exposure.

Recommendation (ops): pursue Option B with a phased cutback: commit to 185 seats on Outreach for 12 months with a Q3 true-up to 160 if usage trends hold. Have Emily push any onboarding credits into the first invoice.

Attachments: seat_realloc_model.xlsx

Marissa Cole
Sales Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Jonas / Marissa,

Appreciate the heads-up. We can offer a bundled discount if Outreach and HubSpot are signed to aligned terms. A few notes:
- HubSpot requires a 24-month minimum for the top-tier blended discount (12–15%) as Marissa noted; a 12-month deal drops to ~8% blended.
- We can include a $10k onboarding credit toward integration work if HubSpot is primary billing.
- I am happy to draft a DocuSign bundle preview. Link to preview: https://app.hubspot.com/docusign/ACME-2026-BUNDLE

If you want to keep exposure lower, consider the phased Outreach reduction plus a 12-month HubSpot renewal with an 8% discount; that buys flexibility.

Regards,

2) Finance ask: Laura — please confirm PO path. If bundled contract comes in under $200k ARR we can approve via standard PO process; if it exceeds that we need VP Finance sign-off. Please advise timing — we need to get countersigned before 11/15.

4) Procurement: Emily / Daniel — can you both send final contracts (Outreach revised quote reflecting phased reduction + HubSpot 12mo doc with the 8%) and include any onboarding credits in the first invoice. We prefer DocuSign for signatures.
